repo.description:
_Maintainers Note: Advisory has been edited for publishing_

Summary

Paperless-ngx AI classification workflows can access information outside the intended document permission scope when processing a document without an owner.

Under affected configurations, private document excerpts and metadata belonging to other users may be included in classification requests sent to the LLM provider. Private metadata may also be applied to the ownerless document.

Affected configurations

The issue requires AI features to be enabled and an AI classification workflow to process an ownerless document.

Cause and impact

The classification path interprets an absent document owner as an unrestricted processing context. This can bypass permission restrictions when selecting related documents and metadata.

Potential consequences include:

Disclosure of private document titles and content excerpts to the configured AI provider.

Disclosure or application of private tags, correspondents, document types, and storage paths to an ownerless document.

Actual exposure depends on workflow configuration, available related documents, and AI provider settings.
repo.summary: Cross-user information disclosure in AI classification workflows on ownerless documents
